name: Ed Brown
source:
The chief of Beyond Coast Police's Vice Unit. He was Jonathan's partner during their days in the LAPD and was also one of the Original Cops. He is a devoted father to both of his children, Anna and Marc. He renews his partnership with Jonathan after 28 long years to solve Lorraine's murder.

[From [url=https://metalgear.fandom.com/wiki/Policenauts]Fandom[/url]]
